description: Connects veterans to their earned state and federal benefits. Provides claims assistance, discharge upgrade help, outreach, and advocacy for Lane County veterans and their families. Free accredited representation.

section_desc: Benefits, support, and community for military veterans and their families

name: Oregon Department of Veterans' Affairs (ODVA)
description: State agency providing programs and services to maintain and enhance the quality of life for Oregon veterans, ensuring basic needs are met. Administers veteran home loans, education benefits, and additional state-specific programs.

section_desc: Benefits, support, and community for military veterans and their families

name: Veterans Crisis Line
description: Free, confidential crisis support for veterans, service members, and their families. Available by phone, text, or chat 24/7. Staffed by responders, many of whom are veterans themselves.

section_desc: Benefits, support, and community for military veterans and their families

description: Located in the Erb Memorial Union, provides study and meeting space, computer and printing stations, and dedicated staff to assist student veterans, dependents, and family members with personal and academic needs at the University of Oregon.

meta.text: Search 211info.org for faith-based programs near you
